$comment: AEP-0002 Annex A machine-usable mapping fixture for the VS Code agent (Copilot) table — the 8 VSCode-target agent-hook events (Preview) -> core types + the vendor-extension fallback. Verified against the pinned vendor source (microsoft/vscode release/1.128 = 5264f2156; 1.129.0 tag 125df4672 contract-identical): hookTypes.ts (the VSCode-target event map), hookCommandTypes.ts + chatHookService.ts (per-event stdin payloads). Each entry pins the pure hook->event mapping at the adapter default posture (capture metadata; attention.* redacted). Envelope identity (session_id -> session, OPTIONAL on this surface; runs SYNTHESIZED per UserPromptSubmit — no turn id exists) and the opt-in held PreToolUse permission gate (AEP_VSCODE_CONTROL=1) are runtime state, pinned by the reference adapter smokes. Coverage honesty, pinned here as absences: the VSCode target has NO SessionEnd, NO failure twin for PostToolUse (success-only), and NO StopFailure/ErrorOccurred — session.ended, tool.failed, and run.failed have no vendor moment on this surface.

identity.$comment: session_id is optional in the vendor envelope (built in executeHook); the adapter defaults a missing one to 'unknown'. No turn id is documented; the adapter synthesizes one run per UserPromptSubmit/Stop pair. tool_use_id pairs tool events exactly. transcript_path (a workstation-local file path) is deliberately never forwarded.

expected.$comment: source is 'new' (the only documented value today); agent_type is the built-in or custom agent/mode name, a metadata-grade fact. The envelope timestamp and transcript_path do not ride: adapter clock is the sibling convention, and the transcript path is workstation-local minutiae.
